title: Ayurvedic Formulary of India (AFI) & Pharmacopoeia Prior-Art Formulations

formulations.name: Chyawanprash
formulations.preparation_method: Avaleha (medicated jam/electuary prepared by boiling herbal decoction with sugar pulp and frying in ghee/sesame oil)
formulations.patentability_status: Non-patentable per se in India under Section 3(p) as it is codified TK in Charaka Samhita.

formulations.name: Dashmoolarishta
formulations.preparation_method: Arishta (fermented liquid preparation made by fermenting decoction of Dashmula with Dhataki flowers and jaggery)
formulations.indication: Sootika Roga (Post-natal care), Vata Disorders, Fatigue, Anaemia
formulations.patentability_status: Non-patentable per se under Section 3(p). Novel standardized active fractions can be evaluated under Phytopharmaceuticals.

formulations.name: Haridra Khanda
formulations.preparation_method: Khanda (granules prepared by frying turmeric in ghee, cooking in milk & sugar, adding fine powders)
formulations.patentability_status: Codified TK. Broad turmeric claims are barred by TKDL prior art (e.g., USPTO turmeric patent revocation by CSIR).

formulations.name: Triphala Churna
formulations.preparation_method: Churna (fine powder of equal parts of dried fruit rinds of the three fruits)
formulations.patentability_status: Codified TK. Basic combination is unpatentable.

formulations.name: Yograj Guggulu
formulations.preparation_method: Vati / Gutika (tablet formulation by purifying Guggulu in ghee and binding with herbal powders)
